brief:
Israeli restrictions on movement and medical supplies have effectively halted cancer treatment across Gaza, leaving patients without viable options for care, according to reporting by Zeteo. The blockade has crippled the health system's ability to provide chemotherapy, radiation, and other essential oncology services. Palestinian cancer patients describe facing a choice between certain death from disease or the dangers of attempting to reach hospitals in Israel or neighboring countries.

The collapse of Gaza's medical infrastructure extends to the West Bank, where patients also struggle to access treatment. Shortages of medications, equipment failures, and the inability to refer patients for specialized care have created a healthcare crisis affecting thousands of Palestinians with cancer diagnoses.
dek: Israel’s genocide is destroying the health system in Gaza and the West Bank – leaving Palestinian cancer patients with few to no options for treatment.
title: Israeli blockade denies Gaza cancer patients access to treatment
